description: `(route, state) => MaybeAsync<T | RedirectCommand>`. The router waits for the value before activating the route.
Route property mapping keys to resolvers: `resolve: { user: userResolver }`. Results land in `ActivatedRoute.data` and, with input binding, in inputs of the same name.
Returned from a guard or resolver to redirect. Accepts navigation options such as `skipLocationChange`.
Resolvers block navigation until data arrives. Loading inside the component (httpResource, resource) shows the page immediately with a loading state.
Route option controlling when resolvers re-run: `'paramsChange'` (default), `'paramsOrQueryParamsChange'`, `'always'`...
